title: Expanding fare-free bus passes
summary: Bill 95 (2026), which expands fare-free bus pass eligibility to boost Maui bus ridership, passed first reading 8–0 on July 24 after the council adopted Committee Report 26-54. The bill would also write the new fiscal year 2027 bus fares, in effect since July 1, into County code. The transportation director estimated each free-ride day, such as for the Maui County Fair or Earth Day, would forgo about $2,806 in fares, and free regular routes would also make paratransit free.
